title: Host SSH Provisioning Variables
description: Variables for the provision_host role's SSH provisioning operations. Names are flat, camelCase, and prefixed with provisionHostSsh.

provisioning_username.description: SSH username used to connect to a host that is being provisioned. Supplied at run time on the command line (-e provisioning_username=...); never persisted.

provisioning_password.description: SSH password used to connect to a host that is being provisioned. Supplied at run time on the command line (-e provisioning_password=...); never persisted.
